title: Double-spend through a wallet ledger race condition
threat: Customers or bots sending concurrent withdrawal and scheduled savings-debit requests
vulnerability: Ledger mutation endpoints lack row locking and idempotency keys
business_impact: Negative balances and direct loss of customer funds; CBN scrutiny
rationale: Race conditions reproduced in load testing; endpoints reachable from the mobile app; loss is direct and large.

title: Fake deposits via spoofed payment gateway webhooks
threat: Attackers forging settlement webhooks from the payment processor
vulnerability: Webhook signatures not verified; no server-to-server re-query before crediting wallets
business_impact: Wallets credited without real settlement; unrecoverable losses
rationale: Webhook endpoint is internet-facing and unauthenticated; forging is easy once the payload format is known.

title: Exposure of BVN and identity images from document storage
threat: Internet scanners and opportunistic attackers searching for open cloud buckets
vulnerability: Bucket policy allows broad read access; images kept indefinitely after verification
business_impact: Mass exposure of NIN/BVN images and selfies; NDPC notification and fines
rationale: Over-permissive policy found in a configuration review; the impact of exposure is severe for a fintech.

title: Unauthorised redemptions via leaked fund manager API credentials
threat: Credential theft from code repositories or developer machines
vulnerability: Long-lived bearer tokens hardcoded in services; no mutual TLS
business_impact: Liquidation of pooled treasury bills to attacker accounts; SEC sanctions
rationale: Tokens have never been rotated since go-live; a single leak would allow redemptions.

title: Customers viewing or unlocking others' savings goals (BOLA/IDOR)
threat: Authenticated users enumerating goal IDs in API requests
vulnerability: Sequential integer IDs and no object-level ownership checks
business_impact: Exposure of balances and premature unlocking of locked savings
rationale: API testing reproduced access to another test user's savings goal.

title: Mispriced T-bill yields from a poisoned or stale pricing feed
threat: Upstream feed errors or tampering in transit
vulnerability: No variance checks before prices drive automated orders
business_impact: Wrong valuations and orders; customer compensation and SEC reporting
rationale: Feed outages occurred twice last quarter and there is no automated sanity check.

title: Account takeover through social engineering of support agents
threat: Fraudsters impersonating high-value savers
vulnerability: Tier-1 agents can reset 2FA devices and phone numbers without re-verification
business_impact: Drained wallets after SIM-swap style takeovers
rationale: Industry-wide trend; agents perform resets daily with weak identity checks.

title: Card data captured in web app storage or error logs
threat: Malicious scripts or log access exposing card numbers
vulnerability: Custom card form handles raw PAN/CVV in the browser and in error telemetry
business_impact: PCI DSS breach, card scheme fines and loss of card acquiring
rationale: Not observed in logs, but the design allows it and the impact would be severe.

title: Insider abuse of the investment admin portal
threat: An operations administrator acting maliciously or under coercion
vulnerability: Super-admin rights without maker-checker on portfolio changes or bulk exports
business_impact: Manipulated allocations and leaked investor records
rationale: Three staff hold super-admin rights and no dual control exists.

title: SMS OTP interception or delay through a single aggregator
threat: SS7 interception, SIM swap or an aggregator outage
vulnerability: A single SMS aggregator and SMS-only one-time passwords
business_impact: Failed or intercepted transaction signing; customer complaints
rationale: Aggregator outages are on record; interception is rare but possible.

title: Unmasked customer PII in the reporting database
threat: Analysts or a compromised analyst account querying the replica
vulnerability: BVNs and phone numbers are unmasked in the BI replica
business_impact: Internal data leak and a reportable NDPA breach
rationale: Access is limited to a small team over VPN, but any exposure would be reportable.

title: Money laundering through structured micro-deposits
threat: Launderers using mule accounts and daily micro-savings
vulnerability: Fraud rules check single transactions, not 30-day velocity
business_impact: Regulatory sanctions and reputational damage
rationale: The Alajo model naturally produces many small deposits and the rules are blind to structuring.

title: Credential stuffing and BVN lookup abuse on the KYC API
threat: Bots replaying breached credentials and abusing lookups
vulnerability: No rate limiting or bot protection on the KYC endpoints
business_impact: Exhausted BVN lookup quota and leaked verification status
rationale: Spikes in failed sign-ins observed and the endpoint is unprotected.

title: Fund manager API downtime delaying unit allocations
threat: Outages at the external fund manager
vulnerability: Synchronous dependency with no queueing or fallback
business_impact: Late unit allocations and customer complaints
rationale: Two outages this year; the business tolerates T+1 reconciliation.

title: Privileged insider manipulation of ledger balances
threat: A database administrator altering balances
vulnerability: Direct database access without dual authorisation or session recording
business_impact: Undetected theft from customer wallets
rationale: Few people hold this access, but the impact would be severe.

title: Ransomware encrypting the customer database and backups
threat: Ransomware groups targeting African fintechs
vulnerability: Backups are online and writable from production
business_impact: Savings service down for days, with possible data theft
rationale: The sector is actively targeted and backups are not immutable.

title: DDoS against the mobile and web apps at peak savings hours
threat: Hacktivists or extortion groups
vulnerability: Origin servers exposed without a DDoS protection service
business_impact: Missed savings debits and customer complaints
rationale: Attacks on Nigerian fintechs are reported regularly; an outage would last hours.

title: Fake account creation with synthetic identities
threat: Fraud rings creating accounts for mule activity
vulnerability: Weak liveness checks and no device fingerprinting at onboarding
business_impact: Mule accounts, chargebacks and regulatory attention
rationale: Some suspicious sign-ups have been detected manually.

title: Data breach at the customer support SaaS vendor
threat: Compromise of the vendor's platform
vulnerability: Support tickets containing customer PII are held by the vendor
business_impact: PII exposure and NDPA notification duties
rationale: The vendor is certified but holds sensitive tickets.

title: Sender-ID spoofing used to phish Alajo customers
threat: Phishers sending SMS and emails that look like The Alajo
vulnerability: Sender IDs are unregistered and DMARC is not enforced on the email domain
business_impact: Customers tricked into sharing PINs and one-time passwords
rationale: Customers report phishing messages every month.

title: Missed or double scheduled debits in the savings engine
threat: Job failures or retries in the debit scheduler
vulnerability: Debit jobs are not idempotent
business_impact: Customer complaints and refunds
rationale: Rare incidents in the past year.

title: Stale portfolio data after failed synchronisation
threat: Sync job failures
vulnerability: No alerting on failed synchronisation runs
business_impact: Customers see outdated holdings until the next sync
rationale: Low impact: data is corrected at the next successful sync.
